headword: {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}

definitions.gloss: price increase; price rise; price escalation
definitions.explanation: An increase in the price of goods, services, or assets. A fundamental economic concept frequently discussed in news, business, and everyday conversation about the cost of living.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食料品|しょくりょうひん}→食料品：01439_shokuryouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The rise in food prices continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}→反映：04327_hanei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The rise in raw material prices is reflected in product prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}→輸入品：11505_yunyuuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{圧迫|あっぱく}→圧迫：12013_appaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, rising import prices are squeezing household budgets.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (price) + ⟦{上昇|じょうしょう}→上昇：11296_joushou⟧ (rise, increase). A staple of economic reporting and business news. In recent years, discussions of {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう} have become even more common in Japan due to inflationary pressures after decades of deflation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧な{価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}: sharp price increase
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: price increases continue
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to curb price increases
- {価格上昇|かかくじょうしょう}{率|りつ}: rate of price increase

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧: price hike — more colloquial, implies a deliberate increase by sellers
- {物価上昇|ぶっかじょうしょう}: rise in commodity prices — focuses on general cost of living
- ⟦インフレ→インフレ：04848_infure⟧: inflation — the broader economic phenomenon
- ⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧: soaring, skyrocketing — implies dramatic or sudden increases
